Beach Republic is no longer a beach club. The resort at the north end of Lamai still takes hotel guests in 2026 and has a beach café, but the pool bar has been shut since 2024, parts of the property are fenced off or under repair, and it advertises no pool parties, DJs or Sunday brunch. If you want a beach-club day, go to ARKbar or CLUB SEEN in Chaweng (15–20 minutes away), Cape Away in Maenam on Sundays, or Nikki Beach on the west coast.

Status, 2 November 2026: beach club closed; hotel open and taking bookings; beach café listed as open daily about 08:00–21:00. We'll update this page if the club reopens.

Beach Republic sits on the beach at the north end of Lamai, below the headland towards Silver Beach. Some older guides place it in south Lamai, which is wrong.

What happened to Beach Republic

For years Beach Republic was the place to be in Lamai on a Sunday: a pool club on the sand with DJs, day beds and one of Samui's best-known Sunday brunches. Guest reports since 2024 tell a different story:

  • 2024: guests reported the pool bar shut, the beach and pool area fenced off and the beach club gone; the management replied acknowledging recent changes.
  • 2025: reviewers described parts of the resort closed and under reconstruction, and an older section out of use. By October 2025 one part was described as completely closed and another covered in sheeting.
  • 2026: the hotel is still listed and bookable for November 2026, with guest reviews from January to July 2026. They describe pool villas and helpful staff, but also a property that needs renovation and construction noise from next door. No beach-club events, brunches or parties are advertised.

We found no announcement of a closure, sale, rebrand or reopening date. Treat Beach Republic as a hotel, not a venue to plan a day or night around.

Can you still visit?

You can stay there, and the hotel's Beach Café and Bar serves breakfast through dinner. A drink or a meal there is fine if you're already in north Lamai, but there's no club atmosphere, no DJ and no sunset: this side of the island faces sunrise. If you want to check before going, call the hotel on +66 77 458 100.

Nearby in north Lamai

  • Silver Beach and Coral Cove, a few minutes north: small coves with clearer water for swimming and snorkelling.
  • Lamai beach: the best swimming is in the centre, about 2 km south.
  • Hin Ta and Hin Yai, at the south end of Lamai.

Getting around from Lamai

Lamai is in the standard pickup zone for our tours. If you're heading to Nikki Beach or another west-coast evening, book a driver with a fixed return time, because taxis are scarce on that side after dark.
